purpose: Teach: 脚光/全盛期/迷走/イジメ/争奪/自尊心/趨勢/再犯

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、新治療法が脚光を浴びた時こそ慎重に医療チームで検証します
lines.en: Ren — when new treatments get attention, that's exactly when we need to be careful. We verify everything as a team.
lines.style: Measured, direct. Slight pause after the name. Steady conviction without lecture. The voice of someone who has seen promising methods fail.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療技術の全盛期も技術伝承を医療チームで重視します
lines.en: Yes. Even at the height of medical innovation, we make sure knowledge gets passed down properly. It's a team effort.
lines.style: Quiet affirmation. Even pacing. Gentle emphasis on 'properly'—not hurried. The reassurance of someone who knows continuity matters.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 診断が迷走するケースを、貴院、減らされてますね、先生
lines.en: You've really brought down the number of diagnostic errors here at the hospital, haven't you, sensei?
lines.style: Genuine curiosity with a note of careful respect. Leans slightly forward. Not flattering—observing something he's noticed. Slight rise at the end, inviting her to confirm.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療現場のイジメに医療チームで対策します
lines.en: Yes. Bullying in the medical workplace—we tackle that as a team. It matters.
lines.style: Firm but not harsh. Slight weight on 'tackle.' Not offering false comfort, but stating fact. Tired eyes but steady voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 臓器の争奪戦と倫理問題を、貴院、研究されてますね、先生
lines.en: The competition for organs, the ethics questions—your hospital's doing real research on that, aren't you, sensei?
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuinely interested. Slower pace. Not accusatory—asking because he wants to understand. Slight warmth recognizing the difficulty of the work.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者の自尊心を尊重する医療を医療チームで提供します
lines.en: Yes. We make sure every patient's dignity is at the center of how we care for them. That's something we do together.
lines.style: Steady, grounded. Emphasis on 'at the center'—not peripheral. Quiet conviction. The voice of someone defending something she believes in.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療政策の趨勢を、貴院、注視されてますね、先生
lines.en: You're watching how medical policy is moving, aren't you, sensei? How it's all going to shift.
lines.style: Observant, slightly hesitant—noticing something he's picked up on but isn't entirely sure how to name. Respectful curiosity. Ends with genuine question.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、薬物依存の再犯防止プログラムを医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes. We've taken on drug addiction prevention and relapse programs. It's something the team owns.
lines.style: Close, almost confiding but still professional. Quiet strength. Slight breathiness—this work costs her. Not explaining, just stating what is.
